functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_auth_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    display_name,
    avatar_url,
    auth_provider
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name',
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name'
    ),
    new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'avatar_url',
    case
      when new.is_anonymous then 'anonymous'::public.auth_provider_type
      else 'email'::public.auth_provider_type
    end
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  insert into public.user_settings (user_id)
  values (new.id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

constraints.name: checkpoint_rewards_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((reward_type = 'landmark'::checkpoint_reward_type) AND (landmark_id IS NOT NULL) AND (food_id IS NULL) AND (province_item_id IS NULL) AND (energy_amount IS NULL)) OR ((reward_type = 'food'::checkpoint_reward_type) AND (landmark_id IS NULL) AND (food_id IS NOT NULL) AND (province_item_id IS NULL) AND (energy_amount IS NULL)) OR ((reward_type = 'province_item'::checkpoint_reward_type) AND (landmark_id IS NULL) AND (food_id IS NULL) AND (province_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (energy_amount IS NULL)) OR ((reward_type = 'energy'::checkpoint_reward_type) AND (landmark_id IS NULL) AND (food_id IS NULL) AND (province_item_id IS NULL) AND (energy_amount IS NOT NULL))))
